notes.title: “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” Announced, COMING IN 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894306/d9cd52cae741b78d81f6fc7a009d13a9da7bdeb4.jpg[/img]
An alchemy RPG “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” is to be released in 2025. 

This title is the definitive edition of the Atelier "Secret" series, with brand new content such as additional playable characters and story from “Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout” to “Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key.”

Furthermore, a release date announcement program of “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe pack” has been scheduled for 4th August 2025 at 9pm JST (1pm BST / 2pm CEST). This program will reveal further details and new footage about the game.

“Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” Teaser Site
https://atelier.games/secretdx/us/

Note: Screens are taken from an in-development build. Final product may differ from actual shown footage.

notes.title: The delightful Atelier Ryza JRPGs get a welcome anniversary overhaul
notes.content:
It's been five years since the first Atelier Ryza game launched, bringing its charming blend of colorful anime designs, JRPG combat, and satisfying alchemy to our PCs. That initial entry was far from the first game to bear the Atelier name, which dates all the way back to 1997, yet its most recent trilogy has earned it much more attention among a Western audience. To commemorate the anniversary, Koei Tecmo Games has given all three games a polish, with optimization updates, quality-of-life features, and additional improvements.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Notice regarding AMD graphic drivers
notes.content:
For the Steam version of Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout released on October 29, 2019, there was an issue where in some cases the game would not launch in certain environments due to the AMD Radeon Software Adrenalin 2020 update released by AMD in December 2019. 

As of January 21, 2020, AMD has released the latest version of the driver (20.1.3), and this issue has now been resolved. For those who had issues with the game not launching, please update to this latest version of the driver.

We apologize for the issues this may have caused, and we thank you for your patience and continued support.

notes.title: Update information（2019/11/08)
notes.content:
The following update has been released.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]1: Addition of graphic options[/h1]
“Graphics Options” has been added to the "Startup Environment Settings" screen in the Settings menu of the launcher displayed before the game starts.

On the screen that appears after selecting "Graphics Options", the graphic settings can be adjusted according to your PC environment.
　
[h1]2: Addition of mouse operation settings[/h1]
"Mouse settings" has been added to the "Startup Environment Settings" screen in the Settings menu of the launcher displayed before the game starts. 

On the screen that appears after selecting "Mouse Settings", check “Enable Mouse Operation” to operate the camera, change the distance, and change gathering tools by using the mouse.
You can also use the mouse scroll wheel to select items where list operations are needed such as on the main menu.
In addition, an optional controller button can be mapped to the mouse to control certain options.
Note: To change the gathering tools, press the key corresponding to the RB button while operating the mouse scroll.
　
[h1]3: Addition of A button, B button switch function[/h1]
A function to switch the key corresponding to the A and B buttons has been added to the "Startup Environment Settings" screen in the Settings menu of the launcher displayed before the game starts.

[h1]4: Support for monitors other than 16:9 screen resolution[/h1]
In instances where monitors other than 16:9 screen resolution are used, the issue where full screen mode was not displayed correctly has been fixed.
　
[h1]5: Usability improvement[/h1]
Players can now leave the game from the desk in the Atelier.

[h1]6: Other adjustments[/h1]
The icon added to the desktop when the game is installed has been fixed.
In addition, the issue that the icon might not be named has been fixed.

The bug that occurred at high frame rates has been fixed.

notes.title: Info on upcoming optimization update
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout.
Currently, we have received a lot of feedback from players regarding optimization.
After reviewing player feedback we have been looking into ways to improve the optimization of the game to resolve the mentioned issues. We are planning to release an update soon.

[h1]Update details:[/h1]

[h1]1.	Addition of graphic options[/h1]
An option to adjust various graphic expressions in the game will be added to the launcher displayed before starting the game.
Using the graphic option, you can adjust it according to your PC environment.

[h1]2.	Addition of mouse operations[/h1]
In addition to the keyboard, mouse options can be set from the launcher displayed before the game starts.
You can play the game using the mouse by setting any controls to various buttons on the mouse.
Activating the “Allow mouse operation” option enables camera operation with the mouse.

[h1]3.	Adjustment of screen resolution setting[/h1]
Regarding the screen resolution that can be set in “Settings” of the launcher displayed before starting the game, it will be adjusted so that the maximum resolution can be selected according to the connected monitor even if it is not in full screen mode.

[h1]4.	Improvement of usability[/h1]
A function will be added so players can leave the game from the desk in the Atelier.

notes.title: About frequently asked questions
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout.
We have answers to the questions that many of you have been asking.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]1.	How to check the manual[/h1]
In the game, press the “N” key on the keyboard while the main menu is open to launch the browser and display the web manual.
If the controller is connected, it can also be displayed by pressing the corresponding button.
You can also check the web manual from “View the Manual” in the middle of the store page.

[h1]2.	Changing the screen resolution[/h1]
Please try the following procedure:
(1) Click “Game” -> “View Game Library”.
(2) From the left menu, select Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout. and click "Play".
(3) The setting tool will start, so click "Settings".
(4) Check the "Full Screen" checkbox.
(5) Select full screen resolution in screen resolution.

* If the full screen resolution cannot be selected in step (5):
(6) Start the game and end with "Exit Game" from the title screen.
(7) Repeat steps (1) to (4) again to select full screen resolution. Select and start the game.
This will be adjusted in the upcoming optimization update to make it easier to select.

[h1]3.	Gameplay becomes very sluggish/slow under certain circumstances.[/h1]
If the game drops in FPS, try the following steps: 
(1) Start NVIDIA Control Panel.
(2) Open “3D Settings” in “Select Task” and select “Manage 3D Settings”.
(3) Change the "Preferred Graphics Processor" setting to "High Performance NVIDIA Processor" on the "Global Settings" tab and click Apply.
(4) Restart the game.
